newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-HEYNCKES SET FOR REAL JOB, SPANISH PRESS SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HEYNCKES SET FOR REAL JOB, SPANISH PRESS SAYS.

text.p: Tenerife coach Jupp Heynckes is set to take over from Fabio Capello at Real Madrid, according to Spanish press reports on Tuesday.
Heynckes travelled to Madrid to meet Real officals on Monday, but refused to speak to reporters on his return to Tenerife.
A club official said on Tuesday that Heynckes was one of a short-list of three foreign managers drawn up for the job last week, but refused to say whether negotiations were taking place with him.
Heynckes, who was formerly at Borussia Moenchengladbach and Bayern Munich, has already announced that he will not continue at the Canary Island side next season.
